items.html: And in these Nekudot are the discernment of the kings who reigned in the land of Edom and died, as will be written with God’s help. And this is the secret of “And the earth was chaos and void”; for the earth is the last Hey, which is the discernment of the eye, as above. And it is she who was chaos and void, which is the matter of the death of the kings, until their correction came, and then it was said, “Let there be light,” and there was light. And this is “Open Your eyes and see our desolation.”
